evidence.detail: deck_card table has column n (copy count) — the raw data for average copies already exists
preaggregate_card_archetype builds _card_archetype_stats but does not aggregate SUM(n) or total_archetype_decks — so avg_copies and pct_of_decks are not computed
cardtable.jsx shows Card, # Decks, Record, Win %, tournament stats — no avg copies or % of decks column
preaggregate() drops and recreates the table each run, so adding columns to the schema requires no migration

triage.fix_sketch: In `decksite/data/card.py:preaggregate_card_archetype`, add `total_n INT NOT NULL` column and `SUM(dc.n) AS total_n` to the SELECT. In `load_cards()` when archetype_id is set, add a JOIN to the existing archetype aggregation to fetch total archetype decks, then expose `avg_copies = total_n / num_decks` and `pct_of_decks = num_decks / total_archetype_decks` via the `/api/cards2/` endpoint in `decksite/controllers/api.py`. Update `shared_web/static/js/cardtable.jsx` to render these two columns conditionally when `archetypeId` prop is non-empty.
triage.notes: Purely additive: no schema migration, no change to existing data, no data retention implications. Columns are computed aggregates from existing deck_card.n data.
